say:2:1041548402:1.text: Too bad I can't summon a snowstorm here. Imagine frozen flames flickering against the ice—such a dazzling contradiction.
say:2:1041548402:1.source_cn: 可惜不能在这里降下一场大雪，不然，冻结的火焰一定会很美吧。

say:4:1041548404:1.text: If it weren't for <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you'd already be a puff of steam under this blazing sun!
say:4:1041548404:1.male: If it weren't for <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you'd already be a puff of steam under this blazing sun!
say:4:1041548404:1.female: If it weren't for <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you'd already be a puff of steam under this blazing sun!

say:5:1041548405:1.text: Care to settle this with a duel? Sitting around listening to sanctimonious speeches bores me to tears.
say:5:1041548405:1.source_cn: 要来对战游戏吗？好啊，这里只有围在圆桌旁的长谈，可无聊呢。

say:6:1041548406:1.text: Let's see, if I froze your precious flames, what would they become? Just like that heroine immortalized in ice, her burning spirit forever trapped...
say:6:1041548406:1.source_cn: 干脆来试试吧。我很好奇，你的火焰被冻结在冰里会是什么样...

say:7:1041548407:1.text: Would it look like a bug trapped in amber? Or a bird thrashing against the bars of a fiery cage?
say:7:1041548407:1.source_cn: 会像围困在琥珀里的虫子一样吗？还是像想要挣脱出牢笼的飞鸟呢？

say:8:1041548408:1.text: My flames will incinerate both your arrogance and your twisted imagination.
say:8:1041548408:1.source_cn: 是吗？我的火焰将烧尽你无知的自负。

say:9:1041548409:1.text: Do you Hypogeans always spew cruelty with such casual glee? Or is life itself just a meaningless game to you?
say:9:1041548409:1.source_cn: 不要用玩乐的语调吐出残忍的词语，恶魔，你把生命看作什么...

say:10:1041548410:1.text: Isn't it delightful when it can be turned into part of the fun?
say:10:1041548410:1.source_cn: 能成为游乐项目之一，不是很好吗？

say:11:1041548411:1.text: And that glare, such fire in your eyes! Has no one taught you that staring daggers is rude?
say:11:1041548411:1.source_cn: 你的目光里满是仇恨，没人说过用那种目光打量别人很没礼貌吗？

say:12:1041548412:1.text: Showing courtesy to a Hypogean like you would be an insult to the divine itself.
say:12:1041548412:1.source_cn: 对待你这种恶魔，做出任何礼数都是对神明的亵渎！

say:13:1041548413:1.text: Ah, how fascinating. If there's ever an opportunity for a bit of blasphemy, do let me know. I'd hate to miss the show.
say:13:1041548413:1.source_cn: 呀，那就太有趣了。要是有亵渎神明的机会，一定要叫上我哦...
